target.title: fix(browser): filter non-page CDP targets
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Chromium's raw `/json/list` target discovery includes workers, service workers, iframes, and background pages as well as real page tabs. OpenClaw filtered browser-internal URLs but could still expose a non-page target when it had a public URL, making it selectable by browser list, focus, close, and agent flows.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared CDP target filter now accepts only records whose required `type` is exactly `page`, then applies the existing browser-internal URL exclusions. The filter stays at `createProfileTabOps`, the common owner for raw CDP and Playwright-backed tab listings; the redundant URL-only filter inside the Playwright enumerator is removed.

Chromium's `/json/list` serializer always writes `type`, and the Chrome DevTools Protocol defines `TargetInfo.type` as required. Missing or malformed types therefore fail closed instead of retaining a compatibility path that would preserve this bug for non-contract providers.

## User Impact

Browser tab lists and subsequent tab actions contain real page targets only. Service workers, workers, iframes, background pages, and browser-internal pages no longer become user-facing tabs.

## Evidence

- Exact head: `02043b075ea6c0b2bad422a47adc1017e8ae1fc4`
- Exact-head CI: 43 successful jobs, no failures or pending jobs: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29056494244
- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox `tbx_01kx4j5wdtkmvynwee9e55k35n`: 37/37 focused browser tests passed.
- Same Testbox: `pnpm check:changed` passed extension production/test typechecks, oxlint with zero warnings/errors, dependency/package guards, database-first guard, sidecar-loader guard, and runtime import-cycle check.
- Live Chrome 144: raw `/json/list` contained `background_page`, `page`, and two `service_worker` records, including a public localhost `/sw.js`; production `listTabs()` returned only the real `page` and omitted the service-worker id.
- Fresh Codex autoreview: no actionable findings; patch correct.
- Upstream contracts checked: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/master/content/browser/devtools/devtools_http_handler.cc and https://chromedevtools.github.io/devtools-protocol/tot/Target/
